FORM- A 1
[See Rule 23(4)]
ORDER
No. 251(13)/P & RD Dated: 07.02.2008
In exercise of the power conferred by sections 12 and 17 of the West Bengal Panchayat Elections Act, 2003 (West Ben. Act XXI of 2003), read with rules 22
and 23 of the West Bengal Panchayat Election Rules , 2006, 1, the District Panchayat Election Officer and District Magistrate of the district of Nadia, as the
prescribed authority appointed by the State Government in the Department of Panchayats and Rural Development under notification No.623-PN/0/I/3R-3/2004
dated 09.02.2007 for the purpose of rules 22 and 23 of the said rules, hereby published the draft of this order to determine for the Grams specified in column(1) of
the Schedule Tribes members and Women members to be elected to such Gram Panchayats specified in the corresponding entries in columns (2a)m, (2b), (2c) and
(2d) respectively, to divide the area of the Grams into constituencies with serial numbers assigned to them specified in the corresponding entries in column (3), to
allocate to each such constituency seat or seats specified in the corresponding entries in column (4), seat or seats reserved for the Scheduled Castes or the Scheduled
Tribes persons specified in the corresponding entries in column(5) , and seat or seats reserved for Women specified in the corresponding entries in column(6) of the
Schedule.
